test_ZstdWriter_ZstdReader_cycle: test ZstdWriter and ZstdReader roundtrip by writing compressed media bytes and reading them back
test_ZstdWriter_preserves_order: test ZstdWriter and ZstdReader with preserve_order=True maintains document and media ordering
create_ZstdWriter: create a ZstdWriter instance to compress and write media bytes from Document objects to a folder
create_ZstdReader: create a ZstdReader instance to decompress and read media bytes from a folder back into Document objects
test_Media MediaType: test Media objects with MediaType enum values IMAGE, VIDEO, and DOCUMENT carrying binary payloads
